name: draw.io
summary: 离线绘制流程图、结构图和网络拓扑的开源桌面工具。
description: draw.io Desktop 是开源图表编辑器的桌面版本，可在本地绘制流程图、结构图、网络拓扑等图表。适合工作说明、学习笔记和技术文档配图，支持本地保存以及导出图片或PDF。桌面应用基于Electron，采用GPL-3.0；保留原始软件包及第三方组件许可。对应32.3.0源码与发行：https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/tag/v32.3.0 。
releaseNotes:
## Release Notes for 32.3.0

[Windows Installer](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.3.0/draw.io-32.3.0-windows-installer.exe)
[Windows No Installer (zip)](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.3.0/draw.io-32.3.0-windows.zip)
[macOS - Universal](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.3.0/draw.io-universal-32.3.0.dmg)
Linux - [deb](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.3.0/drawio-amd64-32.3.0.deb), [AppImage](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.3.0/drawio-x86_64-32.3.0.AppImage) or [rpm](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.3.0/drawio-x86_64-32.3.0.rpm)

**ChangeLog:**

- Uses electron 44.6.0
- Updates each install type the way it was installed. The Windows installer, macOS and AppImage download updates in the background and show a notice and Help > Restart to Update when one is ready, or install it when you quit. MSI, zip, portable, deb and rpm installs show a notice with a link to the release page instead of running the Windows installer over themselves. Extras > Automatic Updates turns the background checks on and off. Coming from 31.7.0, this update still arrives the previous way [jgraph/drawio-desktop#2569]
- Prints on the printer's own paper size and orientation on macOS, so landscape pages print in landscape on A4 or Letter [jgraph/drawio-desktop#2568]
- Prints pages with a page scale above 100% at full size, they were shrunk a second time since 30.3.11 [jgraph/drawio#5540]
- Adds --embed-svg-metadata to the command line, which adds the properties of shapes and connectors to SVG exports as data-meta-* attributes [jgraph/drawio-desktop#1805]
- Opens the window with the background of the loading screen, which avoids a white flash in dark mode
- Updates to [draw.io core 32.3.0](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio/blob/v32.3.0/ChangeLog). All changes from 31.7.0 to 32.3.0 are added in this build.

**Testing:**

Verified against the packaged, signed macOS build. Windows and Linux packages were verified from the produced release artifacts, their sizes and update manifests, rather than by running them.

Base checks

- Launch, open a file passed on the command line, add and edit shapes, change styles, undo and redo, copy and paste, save, insert, rename and delete pages, and zoom
- Export to PNG, JPEG, SVG, PDF, XML and HTML from the command line, covering scale, border, transparency, cropping, page selection with -p and --size page, and PNG and PDF export from the app
- Diagram round trip in an exported PDF, including reopening the exported PDF and recovering both pages and their contents
- Mermaid and CSV import and the --layout and --normalize options from the command line
- Shape search, stencils and shape libraries, the export dialog and the print dialog
- Settings survive a restart
- The macOS bundle is signed with a Developer ID certificate under the hardened runtime, is notarised and stapled, and the Quick Look app extension is sandboxed, separately signed and registered for this build
- The Electron security fuses are applied, so RunAsNode, the NODE_OPTIONS variable and the node inspect arguments are disabled and the app only loads from the asar
- 259 unit tests pass

Updates

- A new install reports no pending update, shows Check for Updates in the Help menu and Automatic Updates switched on in the Extras menu
- When the editor is told that an update has been downloaded it shows the restart notice and the Help menu offers Restart to Update instead of Check for Updates, and an available update for installs that do not update themselves shows the download notice
- Clicking the notice while no update is pending leaves the app and the open diagram as they are
- Switching Automatic Updates off and on again survives a restart each way
- The rules for which install type downloads, links to the release page or never checks are covered by unit tests [jgraph/drawio-desktop#2569]

Printing

- The paper sent to the print dialog is the page format in portrait order with landscape set for landscape pages, and pages are printed at 100% for every page scale, covered by unit tests [jgraph/drawio-desktop#2568] [jgraph/drawio#5540]

Command line

- --embed-svg-metadata adds the properties of a shape as data-meta-* attributes to the SVG, and the same export without the option adds none [jgraph/drawio-desktop#1805]

Core changes checked in the desktop app

- Exports with a scale and a border have the same border on all four sides from the command line, where the right and bottom border were narrower in 31.7.0, and exports at scale 1 or fitted to a width are unchanged [jgraph/drawio#5559]
- Drafts of unsaved changes are saved as plain diagram data, also for .drawio.svg files, and reopening the file offers the draft and restores the unsaved change
- Tall diagrams and Mermaid files open fitted to the window with every shape in view
- Changes made to an open file by another program are detected while the window is in the background
- The image export dialog shows the new presets
- Mermaid files converted from the command line keep the same layout as in 31.7.0, and an empty Mermaid file still ends with an error instead of writing a file

Checks around the changes

- The window background colour in dark mode matches the editor's background
- The functions the app exposes to the editor page are unchanged and give it no access to Node
- Reads, stats and writes of paths the user has not authorised are still refused, while an authorised file still reads and saves
- File and javascript links are still refused rather than opened externally
- Every update manifest names 32.3.0, and the Windows x64 and arm64 manifests each list only their own installer

usageInstructions:
1. 使用Windows 10 2004（build 19041）或更新版本，选择x64或ARM64便携ZIP，解压整个目录并运行WindowsTerminal.exe，保留同目录运行库和资源。若系统缺少VC++运行库，请按微软官方说明安装相应运行库。
2. 在新标签页菜单中选择已有的PowerShell或命令提示符配置，输入自己的命令。需要WSL时先按微软说明安装WSL，终端不会单独提供Linux系统。
3. 在设置中调整默认配置、字体和配色；需要多个会话时添加标签页或拆分窗格。
faq:
适用于Windows 7吗？不适用，官方要求Windows 10 2004或更新版本。
便携ZIP会自动更新吗？手工取得的包需要自行跟进版本，微软推荐Microsoft Store安装方式。
与PowerShell是同一个软件吗？终端是承载命令行环境的界面，PowerShell和WSL是分别安装或系统提供的环境。官方还提供x86 ZIP、MSIX Bundle等格式，本轮提供x64和ARM64两个便携包。
name: Windows Terminal
summary: 支持标签页、分屏和自定义主题的现代 Windows 终端。
description: Windows Terminal 是微软开源的终端应用，可在同一窗口使用 PowerShell、命令提示符和已安装的 WSL 等命令行环境，支持标签页、分屏、Unicode和自定义主题。适合日常命令操作和开发工作。项目采用MIT许可，本站保留原版便携包及许可。对应1.25.2733.0源码与发行：https://github.com/microsoft/terminal/releases/tag/v1.25.2733.0 。
releaseNotes:
Terminal 1.25 is finally stable!

Here are the highlights:
* A new settings search experience! We have a lot of settings; hopefully this helps you find them.
* A rich "actions" editor that will let you better customize how you interact with Terminal.
* Support for the "Kitty" input protocol, for a highly opinionated way to distinguish keyboard keys and how they were pressed.
* Window persistence with _or without_ the scrollback history.
* Community translations into Ukrainian and Serbian (Cyrillic).
* The ability to configure how wide "ambiguous" Unicode characters are for improved compatibility with Chinese, Japanese and Korean console applications.

Please see the following release notes for additional details.

- [Windows Terminal Preview v1.25.622.0](https://github.com/microsoft/terminal/releases/tag/v1.25.622.0)
- [Windows Terminal Preview v1.25.923.0](https://github.com/microsoft/terminal/releases/tag/v1.25.923.0)
- [Windows Terminal Preview v1.25.1171.0](https://github.com/microsoft/terminal/releases/tag/v1.25.1171.0)
- [Windows Terminal Preview v1.25.1241.0](https://github.com/microsoft/terminal/releases/tag/v1.25.1241.0)
- [Windows Terminal Preview v1.25.1322.0](https://github.com/microsoft/terminal/releases/tag/v1.25.1322.0)
- [Windows Terminal Preview v1.25.1912.0](https://github.com/microsoft/terminal/releases/tag/v1.25.1912.0)

> [!NOTE]
> This version began rolling out to the Dev, Canary and Beta Windows Insider channels when this GitHub Release was created. Other channels will be released as our reliability numbers indicate that we haven't broken anything. If you want to update to this release directly, download it below!

### Why are there so many files? How do I choose?

Please visit our page documenting the different [Windows Terminal Distributions]!

Here are some of the things we backported from the new 1.26 release in the Preview channel.

## Changes

* On newer versions of Windows, Terminal will use faster APIs to query the app catalog to find fragment extensions (#20356)
* Our build system now requires Visual Studio 2026 and Windows SDK 10.0.26100 (#20225) (#20518) (#20609)
* Panes can no longer be reduced below 2 cells in either direction, to prevent screen corruption (#20564) (thanks @zhangxaochen!)
* Tab Search will now "preview" which tab you are about to jump to while you're searching (#20256)
* Terminal will now cause DWM.exe to use less memory per Terminal window! (#20655) (thanks @YexuanXiao!)
* The "Open New Window" action has been improved to make it impervious to app execution alias failures (i.e. `wt.exe` being corrupted) (#20311)
* The info bar exhorting you to please not disable the "Touch, Keyboard, and Handwriting Input Service" has been removed (#20633)
* We got rid of the "new tab" animation, as it made the application appear slower (#20543)
* We have expanded our "built-in glyph" support to cover a large portion of the new Unicode "Symbols for Legacy Computing" block (we now cover `U+1FB00` through `U+1FB94`, all sextants, filled triangles and trapezoids, and eighth blocks) (#20424)
* When you close a tab, Terminal will now unconditionally jump to the previously most recently used tab (#20272) (thanks @Anshikakalpana!)

## Bug Fixes

* IME candidate windows will no longer be positioned incorrectly when Terminal is maximized (#20627) (thanks @9enki!)
* Terminal will no longer send arrow key inputs (and others) in the middle of an IME composition (#20471) (thanks @sanguneo!)
* Custom shaders which depend on the `time` parameter will no longer experience an early rollover (#20360) (thanks @Zish19!)
* Media paths referring to icon resources such as `foo.exe,-1` will once again work (#20572) (thanks @arista-ms!)
* Terminal should no longer leak memory with some graphics adapters when you are scrolled back into history or experience rendering lag after the machine resumes from sleep (#20723)
* The "Open Current Working Directory" action will no longer attempt to open non-directories (#20697) (thanks @SebTardif!)
* The font face selector in the settings UI will no longer cause Terminal to undergo rapid unscheduled disassembly (#20255) (thanks @danyalahmed1995!)
   * ... it will also no longer instantly forget what you put in it (#20359) (thanks @danyalahmed1995!)
* The JSON settings schema has been updated to include `persistedLayoutAndContent` as a valid option for `firstWindowPreference` (#20475) (thanks @doterik!)
* We now use the most recent Azure Cloud Shell API version, which ensures that you can still access your Cloud Shells (#20620) (thanks @mbifeld!)
* We've fixed some visual artifacts experienced by users of the "QQ Wubi" IME (#20542)

### Reliability

* XBOX controllers will no longer cause Terminal to shuffle off this mortal coil (#20234) (thanks @phil-scott-78!)
* We will take fewer trips to a farm upstate when you use "terminal pane" shortcuts on the Settings, Markdown or Snippets UI (#20458)
* The experimental "reposition mouse cursor with click" settings will now result in fewer "bucket-kicking" events (#20442)

### VT Support

* An application initiating an OSC 52 clipboard write at the same time as a title change will no longer experience a 5-second hang (#20728)
* A VT soft reset (DECSTR) will no longer result in the uploaded soft font (DRCS) being cleared (#20607) (thanks @j4james!)
* Kitty Keyboard Protocol: auto-repeat events now work properly (#20500)
* Kitty Keyboard Protocol: dead keys and numpad Enter now work properly (#20551)
* Kitty Keyboard Protocol: non-ASCII keys, modifier repeats and AltGr keys now work properly (#20052)

### Console Hosting

* ConPTY will no longer retry its cursor position request when the hosting application does not answer it (#20510)
* ConPTY will no longer wait for a DA1 response before finishing initialization (#20536)

With additional documentation, build system, schema, and code health fixes thanks to @tusharsnx, @MichaelK05-dev, @BamBamTram32, @slambek, @raza-khan0108, @nsfxdyj, @DinahK-2SO, @nsfxdyj, @winstliu, and @1816586742-stack.

[Windows Terminal Distributions]: https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/terminal/distributions

usageInstructions:
1. Windows选择x64或ARM64安装器并按提示安装。macOS解压对应Intel或Apple Silicon的ZIP，将Tabby.app放到应用程序目录。Linux选择与系统架构对应的Debian包并由系统软件包工具安装依赖。
2. 打开应用，在配置中选择系统已有的PowerShell、命令提示符或其他Shell，创建本地终端标签页；使用WSL需要先在Windows中安装WSL。
3. 连接自己的服务器时，在SSH配置中填写主机、端口、用户与认证方式；串口连接需选择实际设备和波特率。可用标签页和分屏同时查看多个会话。
faq:
安装Tabby就有SSH服务器吗？它是客户端，远端账号、服务器和网络连接需要自己准备。
和Windows Terminal有什么区别？Tabby还提供跨平台桌面应用及SSH、串口配置；Windows Terminal主要承载Windows本地命令行环境。
其他包在哪里？官方还提供Windows便携包、Linux RPM/AppImage和ARMv7构建；本站先提供主流x64与ARM64成品，同一产品只计一款。
name: Tabby
summary: 支持分屏、SSH和串口连接的开源跨平台终端。

releaseNotes:
# Features

* feat(settings): label a plugin's vault secret by its key's description by @meanaverage in https://github.com/Eugeny/tabby/pull/11765

# Fixes

* fix(terminal): unbounded O(n²) output buffer for tabs that were never focused by @meanaverage in https://github.com/Eugeny/tabby/pull/11722
* fix(terminal): every closed tab leaks its terminal (WebGL cursor blink timer never disposed) by @meanaverage in https://github.com/Eugeny/tabby/pull/11720
* fix(terminal): closed sessions leak via PTY IPC listeners (destroy() re-entrancy) by @meanaverage in https://github.com/Eugeny/tabby/pull/11719
* fix(terminal): send current terminal size in the deferred initial resize by @anseltaft in https://github.com/Eugeny/tabby/pull/11760
* fix(terminal): don't steal focus from modal dialog inputs by @siparker in https://github.com/Eugeny/tabby/pull/11745
* fix(core): don't fire a hotkey twice for one keystroke by @bptrsn in https://github.com/Eugeny/tabby/pull/11769
* fix(app): keep the window draggable by its tab bar while a dialog is open by @meanaverage in https://github.com/Eugeny/tabby/pull/11766
* fix(ssh): pass PuTTY (.ppk) private keys to WinSCP without converting them by @manjotsc in https://github.com/Eugeny/tabby/pull/11767

## New Contributors
* @meanaverage made their first contribution in https://github.com/Eugeny/tabby/pull/11719
* @siparker made their first contribution in https://github.com/Eugeny/tabby/pull/11745
* @manjotsc made their first contribution in https://github.com/Eugeny/tabby/pull/11767
* @bptrsn made their first contribution in https://github.com/Eugeny/tabby/pull/11769

usageInstructions:
1. Windows选择x64或ARM64原安装器并运行；macOS选择Intel或Apple Silicon的DMG，将PicGo拖到应用程序目录。Linux用对应Debian包安装。
2. 打开主窗口，在图床设置中选择自己使用的服务，按该服务官方说明填写仓库、存储桶或授权资料，再设为默认图床。不要将密钥写进公开文档。
3. 将图片拖到上传区或使用剪贴板上传，确认成功后将复制的链接粘贴到笔记或Markdown文档。插件功能按官方插件说明另行配置。
faq:
安装后就能上传吗？需要选择可用的图床并完成其授权或账户配置；具体要求以所选服务为准。
软件免费就意味着图床免费吗？PicGo是开源工具，云存储和图床的价格、容量与访问限制由各自服务提供。
其他格式在哪里？官方另有Windows32位、Linux AppImage与Snap等构建，本轮提供主流64位桌面包；其他构建从官方Release取得。
name: PicGo
summary: 将本地或剪贴板图片上传到图床，并复制可用于文档的链接。
description: PicGo 是开源图片上传与管理工具，可通过拖拽、剪贴板及快捷键上传图片，并复制URL、Markdown等格式的链接。适合写博客、笔记和开发文档；官方提供中文使用资料，支持国内常用云存储及插件扩展。使用自己的图床时需要先配置服务和权限，云服务费用由对应服务决定。采用MIT许可，原包和第三方许可保持不变。对应3.0.3源码与发行：https://github.com/Molunerfinn/PicGo/releases/tag/v3.0.3 。
releaseNotes:
## Features

PicGo v3 is here! A brand-new UI, light & dark theme, built-in [PicGo Cloud](https://cloud.picgo.app/) uploader (free tier on sign-up), cloud album management, and more major updates, along with a bunch of feature improvements and bug fixes!

And we provide [PicGo Skills](https://github.com/PicGo/skills) — A new skill package for AI Agents to integrate with PicGo for uploading images and files! Enjoy!

**v3.0.3** lets the built-in HTTP server upload to a specific saved configuration per request, reduces idle GPU usage on macOS, and fixes PicGo launching twice at login on Windows.

- ✨ **Choose the upload configuration per request** — Add `uploader`, `configName` or `configId` as query parameters to `POST /upload` to send that upload to an existing saved configuration, without switching your default uploader or writing anything to disk. It works for file path uploads, clipboard uploads (empty body) and multipart uploads, so tools and scripts can send different images to different destinations, even concurrently. Invalid or ambiguous options return HTTP `400` instead of falling back to the default uploader. URL-encode names that contain spaces or non-ASCII characters. ([#1447](https://github.com/Molunerfinn/PicGo/pull/1447)) See the [full guide](https://picgo.app/blog/2026/picgo-http-upload-config/) for parameter combinations, uploader IDs and error codes.

```bash
# Upload to the GitHub configuration named "Work"
curl -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:36677/upload?uploader=github&configName=Work" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"list": ["/absolute/path/photo.png"]}'

# Upload the clipboard image to the same configuration
curl -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:36677/upload?uploader=github&configName=Work"
```

| Upload options | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| None | Same as before: use the current default uploader. |
| `uploader=github` | Use GitHub's currently selected configuration. |
| `uploader=github&configName=Work` | Use the configuration named `Work` under GitHub (case-insensitive). |
| `configName=Work` | Search all uploaders; exactly one configuration must match. |
| `configId=<id>` | Match by configuration ID, which stays the same after renaming. |

## Performance

- Perf: Fixed the `PicGo Helper (GPU)` process on macOS continuously rendering frames and staying busy even after the window was closed. PicGo windows now use Electron's default background throttling again. Thanks [@WayneVoyager](https://github.com/WayneVoyager) for the detailed investigation and fix! ([#1435](https://github.com/Molunerfinn/PicGo/pull/1435), closes [#1434](https://github.com/Molunerfinn/PicGo/issues/1434))

## Bug Fixes

- Fix: PicGo launching twice and showing its window at login on Windows when "Launch at startup" is enabled — a leftover login item registered by older versions is now removed, so PicGo starts once and respects the startup mode setting. Thanks [@jincurry](https://github.com/jincurry) for the fix! ([5399f30](https://github.com/Molunerfinn/PicGo/commit/5399f30))

---

## Features

PicGo v3 来了！全新 UI、明暗主题、内置 [PicGo Cloud](https://cloud.picgo.app/) 图床（注册即享免费额度）、云相册管理等重磅更新，还有一系列功能改进与问题修复！

并且我们提供了 [PicGo Skills](https://github.com/PicGo/skills) — 一个给 AI agent 使用的 skills 技能包，方便你的 AI Agent 接入 PicGo 并上传图片、文件！

**v3.0.3** 让内置 HTTP 上传服务可以按次指定上传到哪个已保存的图床配置，降低了 macOS 上空闲时的 GPU 占用，并修复了 Windows 开机自启时 PicGo 会启动两次的问题。

- ✨ **每次上传可单独指定图床配置** — 在 `POST /upload` 的 query 参数中加上 `uploader`、`configName` 或 `configId`，即可把这一次上传发到某个已保存的配置，不会切换你的默认图床，也不会写入配置文件。文件路径上传、剪贴板上传（空 body）和 multipart 上传都支持，脚本和工具可以把不同的图片发到不同的目的地，并发请求也互不影响。参数无效或匹配到多个配置时会返回 HTTP `400`，不会悄悄回退到默认图床。配置名里有空格或中文等字符时请做 URL 编码。（[#1447](https://github.com/Molunerfinn/PicGo/pull/1447)）参数组合、图床 ID 和错误码的完整说明见 [这篇指南](https://picgo.app/zh/blog/2026/picgo-http-upload-config/)。

```bash
# 上传到 GitHub 图床下名为 "Work" 的配置
curl -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:36677/upload?uploader=github&configName=Work" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"list": ["/absolute/path/photo.png"]}'

# 把剪贴板里的图片上传到同一个配置
curl -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:36677/upload?uploader=github&configName=Work"
```

| 上传参数 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 不带参数 | 和以前一样，使用当前默认图床。 |
| `uploader=github` | 使用 GitHub 图床当前选中的配置。 |
| `uploader=github&configName=Work` | 使用 GitHub 图床下名为 `Work` 的配置（不区分大小写）。 |
| `configName=Work` | 在所有图床中查找，必须恰好匹配一个配置。 |
| `configId=<id>` | 按配置 ID 匹配，配置改名后 ID 不变。 |

## Performance

- 优化：修复 macOS 上 `PicGo Helper (GPU)` 进程持续出帧、关闭窗口后占用也不下降的问题。PicGo 的窗口重新使用 Electron 默认的后台节流策略。感谢 [@WayneVoyager](https://github.com/WayneVoyager) 细致的排查与修复！（[#1435](https://github.com/Molunerfinn/PicGo/pull/1435)，修复 [#1434](https://github.com/Molunerfinn/PicGo/issues/1434)）

## Bug Fixes

- 修复：Windows 上开启「开机自启」后，登录时 PicGo 会启动两次并弹出窗口 — 现在会移除旧版本遗留的登录项，PicGo 只启动一次，并遵循启动模式设置。感谢 [@jincurry](https://github.com/jincurry) 的修复！（[5399f30](https://github.com/Molunerfinn/PicGo/commit/5399f30)）

usageInstructions:
1. Windows 10或11按x64或ARM64选择完整ZIP，解压后运行marktext.exe，保留全部目录文件。macOS 11及更新系统解压对应Intel或Apple Silicon的ZIP，将MarkText.app放入应用程序目录。Linux x64选择Debian包，由系统软件包工具安装依赖。
2. 打开或新建.md文件，输入标题、列表和正文；可通过菜单插入表格、代码块和公式。
3. 将文件保存到自己的笔记目录，需要查看原始标记时切换源码模式；在导出菜单选择PDF或HTML，导出后检查图片和字体。
faq:
需要注册或云账户吗？本地编辑不要求账号，图片上传等联网服务需另行配置。
Windows ZIP与安装器有什么区别？本站Windows主源优先Scoop的原版ZIP；官方还提供安装器，可从Release取得。
Linux有ARM64包吗？这个稳定Release的Linux成品是x64，不将缺失架构标为支持。
name: MarkText
summary: 支持实时排版、表格和公式的开源Markdown编辑器。
description: MarkText 是可视化Markdown编辑器，边写边显示排版，支持表格、代码块、数学公式以及专注模式，可切换源码编辑并导出文档。适合写笔记、技术文档和博客，项目包含简体中文界面资源，文件保存在本地。采用MIT许可，原包及第三方许可保持不变。对应0.20.0版本源码与发行：https://github.com/marktext/marktext/releases/tag/v0.20.0 。

## ⚠️ Note for macOS users
Builds are unsigned (no Apple Developer ID). After dragging MarkText into Applications, clear the quarantine flag once:
```
xattr -cr /Applications/marktext.app
```

## Verifying downloads
All artifacts are listed with their SHA-256 in `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Verify with:
```
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt --ignore-missing
```

usageInstructions:

2. 执行nvim note.txt打开文本，按i进入插入模式输入内容；按Esc返回普通模式，输入:w保存，:q退出，:wq保存并退出。
3. 在编辑器中输入:Tutor学习基础操作，用:help查看内置文档。配置Lua、插件或语言服务前先阅读官方说明，不将语言服务器误认为所有原包已经内置。

summary: 支持Lua扩展、内置终端和语言服务的键盘驱动代码编辑器。
description:

## Release notes

- [Changelog](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/commit/5885a30e1e1225349079e7a1c4a3848aa8e43e42) (fixes + features)
- [News](./runtime/doc/news.txt) (`:help news` in Nvim)

## Install

### Windows

#### Zip

1. Download **nvim-win64.zip** (or **nvim-win-arm64.zip** for ARM)
2. Extract the zip
3. Run `nvim.exe` in your terminal

#### MSI

1. Download **nvim-win64.msi** (or **nvim-win-arm64.msi** for ARM)
2. Run the MSI
3. Run `nvim.exe` in your terminal

Note: On Windows "Server" you may need to [install `vcruntime*.dll`](https://neovim.io/doc/install/#windows).

### macOS (x86_64)

1. Download **nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz**
2. Run `xattr -c ./nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz` (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
3. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz`
4. Run `./nvim-macos-x86_64/bin/nvim`

### macOS (arm64)

1. Download **nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz**
2. Run `xattr -c ./nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz` (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
3. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz`
4. Run `./nvim-macos-arm64/bin/nvim`

### Linux (x86_64)

If your system does not have the required glibc version, try the (unsupported) [builds for older glibc](https://github.com/neovim/neovim-releases).

#### AppImage

1. Download **nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage**
2. Run `chmod u+x nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage`
   - If your system does not have FUSE you can [extract the appimage](https://github.com/AppImage/AppImageKit/wiki/FUSE#type-2-appimage):
     ```bash
     ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage --appimage-extract
     ./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim
     ```

#### Tarball

1. Download **nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz**
2. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`
3. Run `./nvim-linux-x86_64/bin/nvim`

### Linux (arm64)

#### AppImage

1. Download **nvim-linux-arm64.appimage**
2. Run `chmod u+x nvim-linux-arm64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage`
   - If your system does not have FUSE you can [extract the appimage](https://github.com/AppImage/AppImageKit/wiki/FUSE#type-2-appimage):
     ```bash
     ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage --appimage-extract
     ./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim
     ```

#### Tarball

1. Download **nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz**
2. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz`
3. Run `./nvim-linux-arm64/bin/nvim`

### Other

- Install by [package manager](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/blob/master/INSTALL.md#install-from-package)

usageInstructions:
1. Windows解压对应x64或ARM64便携ZIP，运行imhex.exe并保留插件和资源目录。macOS使用对应Intel或Apple Silicon的DMG，将ImHex.app复制到应用程序目录；先核对官方系统要求，当前文档要求macOS 15及更新系统。Linux x64提供Ubuntu 24.04的Debian包，ARM64提供AppImage。
2. 从文件菜单打开自己要分析的文件，在十六进制视图中查看字节与文本；需要查找时使用搜索功能。建议先用副本练习修改和保存。
3. 在数据分析、摘要或文件比较视图中选择需要的工具。需要解析文件结构时，按官方文档导入对应模式，并确认匹配自己的文件格式。
faq:
普通文本文档适合用它编辑吗？它主要用于二进制数据分析，文字写作通常选择文本编辑器。
为什么启动出现图形问题？标准版本需要支持OpenGL 3.0的显卡和可用驱动；官方另有部分NoGPU构建，本页分发标准版本。

releaseNotes:
![](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2960ebab-246e-4a4c-ab3e-666454f2ff47) ## Improvements - **The Windows installers are now signed** - Huge thanks to SignPath for their help and sponsoring the certificate - The icons look slightly less blurry on low-resolution screens now - There's no longer any gaps in the selection of hex editor cells now with certain scaling factors - There's now better error messages when opening a data source failed. No more "Unspecified Error" - Opening a file that has already been opened now switches to its existing tab instead of just displaying an error - The auto-updater on macOS now automatically unpacks the new version instead of just opening the dmg ## Bug Fixes - Fixed the Windows installer not correctly replacing all files - Fixed dependencies of the deb packages - The Extended ASCII display is no longer active by default now - If you upgraded to v1.38.0 before, you can disable it now by clicking on the Paragraph icon in the hex editor footer. If you didn't upgrade to that version, it will now be disabled by default - Fixed a bunch of issues with the updater that caused it to not work correctly, mainly on Windows - Fixed various issues with the pattern editor. Thanks to @paxcut - Fixed editing values in the data inspector not correctly working - Fixed a crash when clicking Cancel while opening a remote SSH File - Fixed a off-by-one in the process memory data source that would cause the first byte of a region to not display correctly - Fixed a crash when using the @ command palette command - Fixed sorting in the find view table being inverted - Fixed pattern files saved by the pattern editor not getting truncated on disk correctly - Fixed a crash when repeatedly opening files by drag-n-dropping them onto the ImHex Window # Previous Version ## Features - Added multiple new Data Sources - A UDP Provider that can display UDP packets received on a specified port - A SSH Provider that can connect to remote machines over SSH and read files from there using SSH or SFTP - This is pretty cool as it allows live-inspection of the RAM of remote machines over the network by opening `/dev/mem` - Tons of improvements to the Pattern Editor. Huge thanks to @paxcut - The pattern editor now supports semantic syntax highlighting for the PatternLanguage! - Matching brackets are now highlighted when the cursor is next to one - Patterns can now be opened in an external Editor and ImHex will update the pattern live when the file changes - Parenthesis and quotes are now auto-closed when typing them - Breakpoints in the pattern editor can now be toggled by clicking on the line numbers instead. - Fixed various scrolling and scrollbar issues - New and updated Languages! - Added a French translation. Thanks a lot to @antigeky - Added a Polish translation. Thanks a lot to @Shadow775711 - Added a Ukrainian translation. Thanks a lot to @RutarAndriy - Updated the Simplified Chinese translation. Thanks to @only9464 - It's possible now to automatically chose the current system language with a fallback to English if the language is not available - Added mutliple new data inspector rows - Added a "Custom Encoding String" row, allowing quick decoding of selections using custom character encodings - Added a fp24 (24-bit floating point) data inspector row - Added a bfloat data inspector row - Added a configurable fixed-point data inspector row - Added a new Save Editor Mode and Simplified Pattern Editor - Marking Patterns with `[[hex::editor_export]]` will now make them show up in a new tab in the Pattern Data View - This allows for displaying only a limited number of fields in a simplified manner and letting you edit them - Additionally, this allows you to create Game Save File Editors using ImHex's Pattern Language! - By writing a pattern with these attributes, you can load the pattern using the new `imhex --save-editor ` option to show only a simplified save editor UI - This can also be done using the Web Version of ImHex by appending `?save-editor=` to the URL where `` is the ID of a GitHub Gist containing the pattern file - Added a "Go To" command to the command palette for quickly jumping to specific offsets - Added new "Go To First/Last Element" buttons to the data inspector - Added option to show extended/unprintable ASCII characters in the Hex Editor view - Vastly improved the auto updater - Added support for updating nightly builds - Added support for switching between stable and nightly channels - Added command palette option to open / focus a specific view - Added option to skip over large chunks of bytes with the same value - Added all tools to the command palette for quick access - Added a Markdown renderer to ImHex - The Changelog in the About page now uses this to render the changelog nicely - Bookmark comments can now also use Markdown formatting - Added a new File Information command line option that can show various information about a file without opening it - This can be used by running `imhex --file-info ` - If this file is supported by a pattern, it will also be loaded and additional information can be displayed - This works by it calling the pattern's `get_data_description` function if it exists which may then return any markdown text to be displayed - This information will also be displayed in the Data Information view - Added a "Decode as Encoding" option to the right-click menu in the Hex Editor view for quickly decoding selected bytes using a specific character encoding - It's now possible to jump to Yara matches in the Hex Editor by clicking on them - Added a region sidebar list to the Intel Hex and Motorola SREC providers. Thanks to @sonorousfreq - Added keyboard shortcuts to jump to next/previous difference in the Diff View. Thanks to @Zman350x - There's now a interactive help button in the title bar that can be clicked to get information about specific elements in the UI - Added a RGBA8 and RGB565 minimap visualizer - Added option to the Minimap to shade cells based on the magnitude of the byte values - Added a Copy and Edit option to the right click menu of patterns in the Pattern Data View - Replaced the useless Constants View with a new Constants Search option in the Find View - This lets you search for a predefined list of common constants such as CRC polynomials - These can also be extended by simple constant json files ## Improvements - **Startup times have been significantly improved** - On my machine, ImHex now starts up in ~60ms instead of taking multiple seconds - ImHex now also uses significantly less RAM. Idle it uses around 60MB now instead of over 200MB before - Pretty much everything has a nice new icon now - ImHex now builds and runs on 32-bit Windows systems - No official 32-bit builds will be provided, but you can build ImHex from source for 32-bit Windows now if needed using MSVC - Decluttered and modernized many parts of the UI - The main menu items now update automatically depending on what view is currently focused - This makes it much easier to figure out which option affects what, especially for things like "Open" which can apply to multiple views - Added Subpixel Font Antialiasing. Huge thanks to @paxcut - This makes all text look significantly nicer, especially on lower resolution screens - Fonts can now be more freely chosen using a new Font File picker that updates immediately - Font names in the picker are now also shown in their respective font - Frame Rate limiting is now much more precise and ImHex will wake up from sleep less often - ImHex will now also not limit the frame rate as much if there's any animations playing to allow for a smoother feel - Updated all dependencies to their latest versions - The Import Pattern popup now shows up much quicker. Thanks to @shewitt-au - Improved handling of cached providers such as the GDB provider to provide more up-to-date data and avoid hangs - The GDB provider now works without the server supporting the NoAckMode - This allows ImHex to be used for example to connect to a Nintendo Switch running Atmosphere - Modernized the TTY Console view with a new layout and a nice diagram showing what the different options affect - Instead of just minimizing the window when clicking the close button on macOS, it will now close the currently opened providers and only when clicked again on the welcome screen it will fully exit ImHex - Individual plugins may now be disabled from the Plugins settings page - ImHex now no longer uses the name "Providers" but instead uses "Data Sources" to better reflect what they do - Most of the Hex Editor settings are now saved - Included a launcher script with most builds that can be added to the PATH to easily launch ImHex from the command line - Integer Literals may now be used in binary patterns. For example `12 34 ?? u32le(123)` - Hashes are now being calculated in a background thread as to not freeze up the UI anymore ## Bug Fixes - **Certain achievements now no longer trigger every time ImHex is started** - Fixed a crash when using the Edit -> Disassemble Selection option before the Disassembly view has been opened - Undo now works for importing patterns in the pattern editor - Fixed many crashes related to the pattern data view - Things like sorting or filtering should now work much more reliably - Fixed the `--reset-settings` command line option not working - Fixed searching for negative numbers in the find view not working correctly - Fixed some crashes on Wayland when exiting ImHex - Empty Intel Hex and Motorola SRec files no longer appear as being one byte long - Fixed issues when reordering toolbar items - Fixed the Open File in Explorer option not working correctly on Windows - Fixed Auto Backups not being properly created after the first time. Thanks to @paxcut - If a crash happens in a background thread, ImHex is now able to properly handle the crash instead of just silently exiting ## Artifacts - Added new ARM64 builds for Windows and Linux - Added new Snap packages for Linux - Added new Flatpak packages for Linux - Added a Fedora 43 rpm package - Added a Ubuntu 24.04 deb package ## Pattern Language - Templates are now much better supported. Huge thanks to @AkiSakurai - They can now be nested properly - Their scoping now works much more sensibly - If you used Templates before, you might need to adjust your patterns. The scope of parameters passed to templates is now that of the template instantiation, not where the variable is actually used. So it's no longer necessary to use `parent` - `sizeof(SomeType)` now works when there's pointers involved - Many functions that previously only worked with the main section are now section-aware - Conditionals now support short-circuit evaluation - Fixed many fixes that caused crashes when errors happened in attributes - Pattern post-processing finishes now much much quicker - Parsing of floating point literals is now no longer locale dependent - Fixed patterns passed to functions by references having their name changed unexpectedly

If you like my work, please consider supporting me on GitHub Sponsors, Patreon or PayPal. Thanks a lot!

releaseNotes:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v0.66.0 -->

This is by far the biggest release since I took over maintainership from Jesse, and some of the changes deserve a bit more explanation than usual.

- **Staging hunks is now done directly from the main view.**

  There used to be a separate staging panel that you had to enter if you wanted to stage individual diff hunks; it was limited to one file at a time, and showed the raw git diff rather than the configured diff renderer. This is gone; the main view now has a selection when you focus it, and you can act on the selected hunk or line directly there:
  - press space to stage a hunk or range of lines
  - navigate to the next/previous hunk with `<right>`/`<left>`, or the next/previous file with `n`/`N`
  - press `e` to jump to the editor on the selected line
  - press `d` to discard a hunk.

  Many other enhancements were added to this new interactive diff view:
  - alt-click a line to jump to that line in the diff view (this works even when a popup panel is showing above it, e.g. the commit message editor)
  - press `<ctrl-g>` to see a menu with all the files in the diff, to quickly jump to one of them
  - the files in the diffstat below the commit message are clickable hyperlinks that take you to the clicked file in the diff, like the `<ctrl-g>` menu does
  - when changing the diff context using `{`/`}`, or when toggling the "ignore whitespace" option (`<ctrl-w`), the scroll position is preserved

  If you use a [custom diff renderer](https://github.com/jesseduffield/lazygit/blob/master/docs/Custom_DiffRenderers.md), all of this works with the renderer's output, as long as it supports the new OSC protocol that was introduced for this. Delta and Diff-so-fancy already do, so if you use one of these, be sure to update them to the latest version. There is support for difftastic too, but it hasn't been accepted upstream, so you'll have to build it yourself from [this PR](https://github.com/Wilfred/difftastic/pull/1014). If you use any other diff renderer, please file an issue so that we can add support for it.

- **Better support for stacked branches.**

  - You can now push or force-push all branches of a stack at once, simply by pushing the topmost one. Lazygit will ask you if you want to push the others as well.
  - Same for pulling: if a branch stack was rebased by someone else, you can pull the topmost branch and lazygit will ask you if you want to pull the other branches in the stack too, without checking them out.
  - Branches of a stack are now listed in order in the branches panel. When rebasing a stack it is common for all branch tips to get the same committer date, in which case git sorts them alphabetically, which is confusing. We now have extra logic to preserve the stack order in this case.
  - Unrelated to stacks (but common to show up in that case): when a branch diverges from its upstream (you see `↓3↑5`) it was impossible to tell whether that was because you rebased or rewrote the branch, in which case you want to force push, or because someone else rebased the branch, in which case you want to pull it. Lazygit can now distinguish these cases, and will show the `↓3↑5` in a dimmer yellow in the latter case. What's more, in this latter case you can "pull" the branch without checking it out by pressing `f`, like you already could for branches showing `↓7`.

- **Dark and light themes.**

  Lazygit now determines whether your terminal has a dark or light background, and can use different color themes for each; it can also switch between the two dynamically if your terminal does. You can also pass this information on to your diff renderer if you use one that needs it, by using the new `{{colorScheme}}` template variable in the renderer command.

- **Better rendering of the commit graph.**

  Since the commit graph uses box drawing characters it could only be an approximation; some graph topologies can't be rendered faithfully this way. We now make use of branch drawing characters if the terminal supports them, which solves this problem and also looks better; see #6077 for details.


## All changes in detail
### Features ✨
* Stage, unstage and discard changes directly from the focused main view by @stefanhaller in https://github.com/jesseduffield/lazygit/pull/6035
### Enhancements 🔥
* Improve the Recent Repos menu by @stefanhaller in https://github.com/jesseduffield/lazygit/pull/6016
* List stacked branches in stack order by @stefanhaller in https://github.com/jesseduffield/lazygit/pull/6024
* Improve the randomly picked author colors by @stefanhaller in https://github.com/jesseduffield/lazygit/pull/6062
* Allow telling diff renderers whether the terminal is dark or light by @stefanhaller in https://github.com/jesseduffield/lazygit/pull/6063

usageInstructions:
1. Windows解压对应x64、ARM64或32位ZIP；macOS或Linux解压对应架构tar.gz，保留许可和说明文件，将rg程序目录加入PATH或用完整路径调用。
2. 在自己的文本目录打开终端，执行rg "关键词"搜索当前目录，执行rg -n "关键词"显示匹配行号；带空格的关键词用引号包围。
3. 只列出匹配文件可用rg -l "关键词"；将关键词作为普通文字而非正则时用rg -F "关键词"。先用rg --help查看参数，再根据需要调整隐藏文件及忽略规则。
faq:
为什么有些文件没有结果？默认忽略隐藏文件、二进制文件及gitignore命中的路径，可用官方文档说明的参数调整。
搜索会修改原文件吗？普通搜索只读取匹配内容，不会替换或编辑文件。
中文可以搜索吗？可搜索UTF-8等支持的文本，其他编码应查阅--encoding参数说明。
name: ripgrep
summary: 递归搜索文件内容、支持正则和gitignore的快速命令行工具。
description: ripgrep（rg）用于从目录和文件中查找文本或正则表达式，默认遵守gitignore并跳过隐藏文件与二进制文件，适合查代码、日志和配置。支持Windows、macOS及Linux，需在终端使用。采用MIT或UNLICENSE双许可，本站保留完整官方原包与许可；对应15.2.0源码：https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/tree/15.2.0 。图标为本站制作的rg名称标识，非官方图标。
releaseNotes:
[Sponsorship is appreciated!](https://github.com/sponsors/BurntSushi/)

This release fixes a number of bugs related to gitignore matching as well as
some performance improvements in directory tree traversal.

> In case you haven't heard of it before, ripgrep is a line-oriented search
> tool that recursively searches the current directory for a regex pattern.
> By default, ripgrep will respect gitignore rules and automatically skip
> hidden files/directories and binary files.

Platform support:

* `aarch64-unknown-linux-musl` is now included in the release binaries for
  ripgrep.

Performance improvements:

* [PERF #3293](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3293):
  Improves directory traversal time on very large corpora.

Feature enhancements:

* [FEATURE #3275](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3275):
  ripgrep now respects `GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL` and `GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM`.

Bug fixes:

* [BUG #3212](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/pull/3212):
  Don't check for the existence of `.jj` when `--no-ignore` is used.
* [BUG #3320](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/pull/3419),
  [BUG #3376](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/pull/3376),
  [BUG #3419](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/pull/3419):
  Fix gitignore matching bug when searching across multiple directories.

usageInstructions:
1. Windows解压完整ZIP并运行copyq.exe，保留插件和运行库目录。macOS 13及更新系统安装对应Intel或Apple Silicon的DMG，将CopyQ.app放入应用程序目录。Linux x64使用AppImage，赋予执行权限后启动，或按官方文档使用发行版软件包。
2. 启动后复制一段自己的文字，点击托盘图标打开历史窗口；输入关键词搜索记录，选中条目后按Ctrl+C复制回来，或按Enter粘贴到之前的活动窗口。
3. 用F2编辑条目，按需创建标签页和配置快捷键。先在设置中了解保存历史、忽略窗口和敏感内容检测；不希望记录时暂停剪贴板监控，脚本和自定义命令按官方文档配置。
faq:
退出后历史还在吗？历史通常保存在本地，下次启动会恢复；备份和存储位置按官方文档操作。
为什么Linux或Mac快捷键不能用？快捷键和自动粘贴受桌面环境、Wayland及系统权限影响，按官方FAQ检查，仍可手动复制条目。
可以忽略密码管理器的复制内容吗？官方提供敏感内容检测和忽略窗口等设置，应结合自己所用应用检查效果。
截图是什么版本？页面使用官方文档功能示例，不宣称本站运行测试或当前版本完全相同的外观。
name: CopyQ

releaseNotes:
## Added

- Adds support for GNOME 50 (#3677).

## Changed

- Tab data and state files are moved to XDG-compliant directories,
  `%LOCALAPPDATA%` on Windows and `~/Library/Application Support` on macOS
  (#3692, #3693). State path can be changed using `COPYQ_STATE_PATH`
  environment variable.

  **Important**: This is backwards incompatible. The data and state files are
  moved when the new app version starts. Older versions of the app will not see
  these files and basically lose all items.

- FakeVim is updated from upstream repository.

## Fixed

- Fixes audio engine always using a small amount of CPU and indicating (on KDE)
  that it plays audio (#3684). The engine is initialized only when needed and
  released after it stops playing all audio.

- Fixes initial script dialog size (#3700). Thanks to @wyf-777.

- Fixes slow tab icon lookups when the app contains many item tabs (#3721).
  Thanks to @jkindrix (Justin Kindrix).

- Fixes keeping old tabs in configuration (#3722). Thanks to @sakashimaa.

- Windows: Prevents app from attempting (unsuccessfully) to paste to windows
  the user cannot switch back to (#2556). Thanks to @ntzb.

- Wayland: Fixes global shortcuts failing when portal service starts later or
  restarts (#3616, #3680).

- Wayland: Fixes global shortcuts in non-default sessions (#3713).

- Wayland: Fixes rebinding global shortcuts on start (#3678).
  Thanks to @Memoraike (Meow).

- Synchronize plugin: Fixes GUI freeze when removing items and on startup and
  retrying to remove absent files (#3629, #3697).

usageInstructions:
1. 使用Windows 10或更新系统，将完整portable 7z解压到自己的工具目录；x64机器进入win-x64，Windows ARM64机器进入win-arm64，运行BCUninstaller.exe。保留随附运行时、Licence.txt、NOTICE和其他文件，不仅复制EXE。
2. 等待软件列表扫描完成，先用搜索或筛选找到自己确认不再需要的程序；核对名称、发布者和安装位置，不按颜色直接判断必须删除。
3. 选中目标后使用Uninstall，按向导核对卸载列表并调用原卸载程序。残留检查结果需要自己确认，操作前保存相关数据，首次使用先只卸载一款熟悉的软件。
faq:
需要另外安装.NET吗？本页完整portable包包含运行时；官方net精简包另需.NET 8，本页不把它当完整portable分发。
官网说旧Windows也能用？官网部分要求描述的是旧版本，当前6.x官方README要求Windows 10及更新系统；不要将旧版要求套到本页。
为什么两个Windows架构下载同一个文件？官方完整原包自带win-x64与win-arm64，本站保留原档案并按真实主程序架构提供两个槽位，不重复重打包。
截图怎么写着4.16？使用官网官方历史功能示例，展示软件列表和筛选，不冒充6.3.0实测或当前界面。
name: BCUninstaller
summary: 查看已装程序，批量卸载并检查卸载后残留。
description:
Bulk Crap Uninstaller（BCUninstaller、BCU）用于整理Windows中的已安装程序，支持搜索、过滤、批量调用卸载程序和检查残留。适合清理不再需要的软件，也可先浏览列表了解程序来源。本页采用6.3.0完整portable原包，附带.NET运行时；同一原包包含win-x64和win-arm64两个目录，不拆包或修改字节。主体采用Apache-2.0，保留原Licence.txt、NOTICE及NBug等组件通知；项目经理和主要开发者为Marcin Szeniak。对应源码：https://github.com/BCUninstaller/Bulk-Crap-Uninstaller/tree/v6.3 。产品图标来自官方应用Resources/logo.ico，使用根Apache-2.0。官方主窗口历史示例来自官网gh-pages分支，该分支也采用Apache-2.0，保留作者和来源，本站仅转换为WebP。

releaseNotes:
## Overview

This release expands mind maps and database calendars, adds more ways to customize editing workflows, improves mobile interactions and window management, and introduces workspace storage statistics. It also brings performance improvements and new capabilities for AI, MCP, and plugins.

### Editing, mind maps, and databases

Mind maps now have dedicated block types, bracket summaries, and improved node editing and expansion controls. Database calendars support ISO week numbers, week navigation, and scheduling undated items, while database views gain conditional colors. The command panel can insert blocks, assets, and references, and context menu shortcuts can be customized.

### Mobile, window management, and performance

Mobile editing gains optional searchable slash commands, easier Command Palette access, and pinch-to-zoom for mind maps. New window layouts can be saved and restored, and workspace storage statistics help you see how space is used. Startup, synchronization, long document editing, index recovery, Markdown parsing, and large table rendering are improved.

### AI and extensibility

The built-in MCP server now supports OAuth 2.1, and workspace AGENTS.md files can provide custom instructions for the AI agent. Agent and MCP tools can manage Bazaar packages, while plugins gain directory declarations for publish resources and an asset picker with flexible matching.

usageInstructions:
1. Windows解压对应x64或ARM64完整ZIP，运行其中shotcut.exe；macOS打开DMG并将Shotcut.app放入应用程序目录，该原包同时含Intel和Apple Silicon主程序；Linux x64解压txz，保留完整Shotcut.app目录并用其启动入口运行。
2. 用自己的短视频试用，通过打开文件或拖放载入素材，新建并保存项目，再将片段放入时间线，先完成基本剪切和顺序调整。
3. 按需要调整声音或添加滤镜，再在Export中选择合适预设导出视频，等待任务完成并打开输出文件核对画面和声音。项目文件用于继续编辑，不等于已导出的视频。
4. 使用原版附带资源时保留对应许可；原视频、配乐和图片由自己确认可用。多轨、关键帧等操作按官方教程学习。

releaseNotes:
## What's Changed

See a  [nicely formatted page](https://www.shotcut.org/blog/new-release-26.9.27/) on the web site.

- Fixed security flaws in upgrade and Whisper downloads (failed HTTPS was retried over HTTP, certificate errors could be ignored, and a downloaded file could be used without a trusted digest).
- Fixed **Mask: Draw (Glaxnimate)** filter, **Operation > Subtract** for 8-bit processing mode (broke in version 25.12).
- Fixed using **Size, Position & Rotate** with **Mask: Apply** filters (broke in version 25.12).
- Improved audio quality by removing a conversion to 16-bit integer and keeping the pipeline in 32-bit float.
- Fixed LV2 external audio plugins not loading on Windows (unless `LV2_PATH` environment var set explicitly).
- Fixed VA-API HEVC hardware encoder on Linux.
- Fixed **Show in Folder** not working with non-ASCII characters on Linux.
- Fixed **Import Subtitles from File** not working on Windows.
- Fixed **Subtitles** view shows incorrect duration (broke in version 26.8).
- Fixed moving **Timeline** clip next to another with snap while zoomed out may insert 1 blank frame.
- Fixed copy and pasting a **Timeline** transition corrupt audio in the pasted transition.
- Fixed window title bar missing on Linux with **Settings > Display Method > Vulkan**.
- Fixed marker unexpectedly deleted when moving a clip to the left with **Ripple Markers** on.
- Fixed keyframes on **Timeline > Split** after a transition.
- Fixed **Export** job may report failure even though file was completed successfully.
- Fixed some buffer overflow security issues in PGM/wipe reading in MLT and **Set Equirectangular** in Shotcut.
- Fixed projects deleted from disk still appear in **Projects**.
- Fixed `Ctrl+Up` and `Ctrl+Down` cannot change current track when **Timeline** loses focus.
- Fixed **Player > External Monitor > DeckLink** (and related such as UltraStudio) HDMI/SDI may deadlock. 
- Fixed MLT XML nested clip's length (duration) not updated, now updates when selected but needs manual trim to increase clip.
- Fixed redundant context menu on text edit controls in filters on Windows (broke in v26.8).
- Fixed open project on a mounted CIFS/SMB share on Linux kernel 7.1 and above.
- Fixed possible crash when trying to add subtitle item in the last half second of the timeline.
- Hardened MP4 parsing in **Set Equirectangular** in **Properties** and export job context menu.
- Changed **Settings > Leave Safe Mode** to an always-present **Allow External Plugins** checkbox that defaults to off.
  This helps prevent the problem that some VST2 plugins on Windows and macOS are causing startup and shutdown (including export) problems.
- Detect a stuck application startup to automatically disable external plugins.
- Added **Automatic Audio Ducking** for audio to timeline track **Properties**.
- Changed **Adjust Clip Gain** for timeline clips to require `Ctrl+Alt` (`option+command` on macOS) to drag.
  This makes it safe from inadvertent changes while selecting and dragging clips. So, now that setting
  defaults on again. Also, a tooltip was added to the clip's audio line. 
- Added volume control and audio level meter/indicator to **Timeline** track headers.
  This effectively makes the track header column a mixing console without needing to clutter the UI with a new panel.
  The gain filter this adds to the track is keyframable.
- Added **Timeline > Generate > Adjustment Clip**. This is a dummy video clip that contributes no video.
  Instead, its filters apply to the composite of all video tracks below it.
- Added `application.triggerAction(name)`, `multitrack.clipStart()`, and `timeline.split()` functions for scripts.
- Added a context menu with **Copy** to **Missing Files** dialog and **View > Resources**.
- Improved the performance of the **Timeline**: moving clips to another track, zooming, undo for many operations (except for ripple move/trim).
- Improved the appearance of the user interface to be more modern with rounded corners in many places.
- New logo
- Upgraded FFmpeg to version 9.0

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/mltframework/shotcut/compare/v26.8.1...v26.9.27

### Security

* **security: resolve real path in QuickJS sandbox** by @prateek-bruno in [#9226](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9226) 
Local module paths are now resolved to their real path in the QuickJS runtime, preventing scripts from reaching files outside the intended location (e.g. via symlinks or path tricks). Credits to @wpframe for reporting this.
* **security: stop exposing `__brunoLoadLocalModule` to scripts** by @prateek-bruno in [#9277](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9277) 
Internal module loader is no longer accessible from user scripts, reducing the sandbox's attack surface. Credits to @wpframe for reporting this.

**We recommend all users upgrade to this release.**

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/compare/v4.2.0...v4.2.1

usageInstructions:
1. Windows按x64或ARM64选择完整ZIP，解压后运行NotepadNext.exe；Mac打开对应Intel或Apple Silicon的DMG，把NotepadNext.app放入应用程序目录；Linux x64下载完整AppImage，按系统要求赋予执行权限，并依官方说明处理AppImage运行依赖。保留同版LICENSES.zip及原程序周边文件。
2. 先复制一个自己的TXT、JSON或脚本文件，用文件菜单打开副本，尝试编辑少量文字并另存为新文件，重新打开确认编码与内容。
3. 使用查找入口搜索普通关键词，再按需要尝试正则或替换；通过窗口和标签操作打开多个文件，试用分窗格阅读同一项目的不同文件。
4. 按官方README和设置调整语言、编码、缩进及快捷键。它仍有尚未完成的实现，先在副本验证自己的操作流程，不把未保存内容或关键工作直接交给试验性功能。

name: Notepad Next
summary: 支持代码高亮、多窗格、查找替换的跨平台文本编辑器。
description:

releaseNotes:
## What's Changed
- Added split editor shortcuts.
- Added quick tab controls to the toolbar.
- Added bulk close options for tabs.
- Improved file renaming by pre-filling the rename dialog and correctly removing the old file.
- Added the ability to search and bookmark lines.
- Added a setting to enable or disable auto-completion.
- Improved auto-completion with language keyword suggestions.
- Added `Shift+Enter` as a shortcut for backward search.
- Added `Shift+Scroll` for horizontal scrolling.
- Multiple search results can now be copied at once.
- Improved Find/Replace dialog sizing and behavior on smaller screens.
- Fixed the caret position when opening the context menu inside a text selection.
- Fixed the Unfold All action.
- Fixed an issue where new file names could incorrectly restart instead of incrementing.
- Fixed a crash when a session file cannot be read during startup.
- Added UTF-16 Little Endian and Big Endian encoding support.
- Added initial Windows ARM64 support.
- Improved macOS support, including text navigation key bindings and build reliability.
- Improved Linux AppImage support and added Linux build documentation.
- Updated ADS to version 5.1.1.
- Updated translations across the application.
- Fixed several build and release issues across supported platforms.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dail8859/NotepadNext/compare/v0.14...v0.15

usageInstructions:
1. Windows本页提供Scoop对应的官方nupkg（ZIP结构），用支持该格式的解压工具打开，进入lib/net45并运行Mailspring.exe，保留同目录resources及其他文件；需要安装向导可到官方下载安装器。macOS解压与Intel或Apple Silicon对应的ZIP，将Mailspring.app放到应用程序目录；Linux安装对应amd64或arm64的DEB，交由系统包管理器处理依赖。保留同版LICENSES.zip。
2. 启动后按引导添加自己的邮箱，选择对应服务商或IMAP/SMTP入口。依据邮箱服务商官方设置启用所需协议，并使用其要求的OAuth、应用专用密码或授权码；不要把服务商设置或密码填到软件站。
3. 等待首次同步，先搜索一封自己的邮件，打开阅读；新建一封测试邮件发给自己的地址，核对发件与收件。多邮箱添加完成后按账户或统一收件箱查看。
4. 在偏好设置调整语言、主题、签名和快捷键。邮件追踪、联系资料等Pro能力按官方订阅说明使用；不能连接时先检查服务商授权、服务器设置、网络及官方排错文档。

所有功能都免费吗？基础客户端与Pro订阅能力分开，具体额度和价格以官网为准。

Windows为什么是nupkg？沿用Scoop主源的官方完整包，内部为ZIP结构；安装向导另见官方下载安装器。
为什么官网和这里许可说明不同？本页以1.26.0固定源码及实际原包声明为准，第三方组件有各自随附许可。
name: Mailspring
summary: 集中管理多个邮箱，支持统一收件箱、搜索和邮件撰写。
description: Mailspring 是桌面邮件客户端，可连接多个邮箱，在统一收件箱中阅读、搜索、归档和回复邮件，提供主题及中文界面。适合需要集中处理工作和个人邮件的用户；邮箱接入取决于服务商提供的协议、授权方式及网络条件。基础功能与Mailspring Pro订阅功能按官方说明区分。本页固定1.26.0完整原包，应用和同步引擎的原包声明采用GPL-3.0-or-later，Electron、PDF.js及字体等沿用随附各自许可；保留Foundry 376, LLC和原通知，并附同版LICENSES.zip。源码：https://github.com/Foundry376/Mailspring/tree/1.26.0 ，同步引擎源码：https://github.com/Foundry376/Mailspring-Sync 。产品图标来自官方资源，仅转换为WebP，保留项目来源和GPL许可。
releaseNotes:
## 1.26.0 (10/1/2026)

This is a major sync reliability release - The sync engine now tracks every folder a message lives in, rather than forcing each message into a single folder. This permanently fixes mail "flickering" between folders or disappearing from the Inbox when the same message exists in two places — a long-standing issue for iCloud users, self-addressed mail that lands in both Inbox and Sent, Exchange's duplicate Sent copies, and ProtonMail labels. (#2891) This refactor was enabled by a huge new suite of automated mailsync tests that run against real Dovecot, Cyrus in Docker and fake problematic IMAP servers.

Features:

- Folder and unread counts left wrong by previous versions are repaired automatically on upgrade. Thanks @dansleboby!
- Calendars now refresh every 15 minutes instead of every 45, so invitations accepted on another device or meetings moved by the organizer show up sooner. Contacts sync slightly less often to conserve Google API quota. Thanks @brhellman!
- After an event is saved or deleted, Mailspring re-reads the calendar from the server so the event reflects what the server actually stored. (#2915) Thanks @brhellman!
- Calendars deleted or unshared on the server are now removed from Mailspring along with their events. Thanks @brhellman!
- Mailspring now records whether each calendar is your own or shared with you, so RSVPs are never written onto someone else's calendar. (#2916) Thanks @brhellman!
- Day and week calendar views now draw events with the same chip style as the month view, and selected events fill with the calendar's own color. (#2895) Thanks @manilabui!

Security:

- Links in print preview, quick-preview and "show original" windows now open in your browser instead of loading the remote page in the window.
- Links from auxiliary windows only open in your browser after a real click or keypress, so a meta refresh in a message can no longer open a page on its own.
- "Show All" on a clipped message now sanitizes the message body and blocks remote images like the reading pane.
- Replying, forwarding and sending no longer fetch remote images referenced by the message when automatic image loading is off. Opening an event's notes no longer fetches images referenced by its description, which could tell the sender you opened the invitation. (#2901) Thanks @brhellman!
- A malicious event UID can no longer cause the sync engine to write outside the calendar collection on the CalDAV server. Thanks @brhellman!

Bug Fixes:

- Fixed duplicate Sent copies appearing on Exchange Online, Gmail, Yahoo and Zoho, which file their own copy of sent mail.
- On servers without IMAP MOVE, moving a message no longer permanently erases other messages another client had only marked for deletion (e.g. Outlook's "mark for deletion" mode).
- Fixed several provider quirks: folder roles detected by name and `\Archive` support, servers reporting UIDNEXT 0, Coremail/NetEase servers that require an ID command, and servers that refuse LIST being treated as missing folders.
- Fixed mail rules not applying to self-addressed messages whose Inbox copy arrived after the Sent copy.
- Fixed the Unread view's recently-read threads leaking across views. (#2905) Thanks @dansleboby!
- Fixed Gmail messages losing text the sender placed inside the signature block when there was no quoted text. (#2902) Thanks @dansleboby!
- On Linux, fixed two title bars appearing on KDE and GNOME for users who never chose a menubar style. (#2903) Thanks @dansleboby!
- Fixed blank lines appearing in the inline reply composer. (#2896) Thanks @arnonuem!
- Fixed adding some Google Workspace and Office 365 accounts by always using the provider's servers for OAuth accounts. (#2907) Thanks @Jorl17!
- Fixed the Send button silently doing nothing when a draft's From address matches no account or alias; Mailspring now explains the problem. (#2910)
- Carriage returns are stripped from text dropped into the composer. (#2908)
- Fixed Google contacts with a birthday but no date failing to open in the contact editor. (#2912)
- Fixed an error when a sound effect can't be decoded. (#2911)
- Malformed URLs passed to Mailspring on launch are now ignored. (#2913)
- On macOS 27, notifications now respect the system "Play sound for notifications" setting and Focus modes, and the notification sound plays correctly.
- On macOS, fixed the window not being draggable beneath the window controls.
- Updated Electron to 44.5.1 to fix webview detach errors. (#2909)
- Mailspring now tells you when the server rejects an event save instead of leaving the unsaved edit on screen. (#2914) Thanks @brhellman!
- Fixed RSVPs to recurring events including other guests' attendance in the replies for moved or modified occurrences. (#2917) Thanks @brhellman!
- Fixed recurring events created in winter showing an hour off in summer: VTIMEZONEs now carry the zone's daylight saving rules, including every offset change. (#2885, #2900) Thanks @brhellman!
- Fixed Outlook and Exchange events using Windows zone names ("Central Standard Time") being shifted to your machine's time zone when edited. (#2897) Thanks @brhellman!
- Fixed an invitation that redefines the UTC zone shifting every UTC time for the rest of the session. (#2898) Thanks @brhellman!
- Fixed UTC timestamps in calendar data being read as local time. Thanks @brhellman!
- Fixed deleting a single occurrence of a recurring event deleting the entire series on the server. Thanks @brhellman!
- Fixed accepting an invitation already present on the calendar failing as a duplicate create. Thanks @brhellman!
- Fixed every calendar being marked read-only on servers that omit or aggregate privilege information. Thanks @brhellman!
- Fixed Fastmail/Cyrus scheduling Inbox and Outbox collections appearing as calendars, and DAV principal discovery on some servers. Thanks @brhellman!
- Fixed RSVP emails violating MIME line-length and encoding rules, which some mail servers refuse. Mailspring also accepts iTIP COUNTER proposals when responding. Thanks @brhellman!
- Fixed a failing manual calendar refresh aborting the sync process. Thanks @brhellman!
- Fixed CalDAV and CardDAV discovery on servers that use 303, 307 or 308 redirects from `/.well-known`. Thanks @Alintya!
- Fixed a blur on a calendar time field moving the event to today, a timed event losing its time when its day is changed, and a bare hour like "3" always being read as PM. (#2890, #2892, #2893) Thanks @manilabui!
- Fixed all-day event saves writing the wrong date span. (#2894) Thanks @manilabui!
- Fixed event notes missing when the description begins with `itemprop=description` meta tags.

Improvements:

- The offline indicator is a less aggressive gray, and coming back online re-syncs your accounts immediately, clearing the indicator.

Developer:

- Added an extensive fakeimap, Cyrus and Dovecot test suite for the sync engine.
- Updated out of date GitHub Actions versions.
- Fixed Playwright assertions for the macOS 27 navigation bar.

usageInstructions:
1. Windows 解压 x64 或 ARM64 原 ZIP，在完整目录中运行 dbeaver.exe；macOS 打开对应 Intel 或 Apple Silicon DMG，将 DBeaver 应用放入应用程序目录；Linux Debian/Ubuntu 安装对应架构 .deb，并按安装器提示满足系统依赖。完整原包保留随附运行环境，不执行 Scoop 的预安装脚本。
2. 点击新建数据库连接，选择 SQLite，用自己的测试数据库文件或副本作为路径；首次使用可能提示联网下载 JDBC 驱动。点击测试连接，成功后完成向导。连接远程数据库时，按实际服务填写地址、端口、数据库名和自己的账户。
3. 为该连接打开 SQL 编辑器，先执行 SELECT 1; 查看结果。随后再浏览测试库中的表和结构，按需要查询或导出数据；写入操作使用自己的测试数据。更多参数和快捷键见官方连接与 SQL 编辑器文档。
faq:
这是免费社区版吗？本页为官方 Community 原包，商用专业版另有产品和授权。
为什么首次连接需要下载文件？部分数据库需要 JDBC 驱动，DBeaver 会按所选数据库提示取得驱动，需要可用网络。
能直接打开 Excel 或任意文件吗？它主要管理数据库，不代替通用办公软件；功能及格式支持按社区版和所选驱动核对。
SQL 编辑器中的所有功能都是社区版功能吗？官网文档覆盖多个版本，按页面的版本说明判断，本站不承诺所有专业功能都包含。
需要什么系统？官方当前要求 Windows 10 或更新版本、macOS 11 或更新版本；原包包含运行环境，按实际系统和 CPU 选择下载。
name: DBeaver Community
summary: 管理多种数据库，编写 SQL 并查看表格数据。
description: DBeaver Community 是通用数据库管理工具，适合连接数据库、浏览表和结构、编写执行 SQL，以及导入导出数据。本站提供社区版官方原包，采用 Apache 2.0 许可，保留 DBeaver Corp 版权及产品标识；专业版的部分功能需另购。对应 26.2.2 源码与发行：https://github.com/dbeaver/dbeaver/tree/26.2.2 。官方完整包保留 Eclipse、JRE 和插件自身的原许可文件；随附 DBeaver-26.2.2-LICENSES.zip 保存主项目 Apache 原文及 Community 产品版权/许可配置。运行环境原版本与许可见包内 jre/release 和 jre/legal，其他组件原文件均保留。

                    - Improved navigation between project and global network profile settings
                    - Improved the confirmation dialog for removing a network handler

usageInstructions:
1. Windows x64 需要 Windows 10 1703 或更新版本，ARM64 需要 Windows 11；运行对应 MSI 安装。macOS 需要 13 或更新版本，打开 Intel 或 Apple Silicon DMG，将 Anki 拖到应用程序目录。Linux x64 需要 glibc 2.35+，ARM64 需要 glibc 2.39+，先按官方文档安装系统库与 zstd，解压原 .tar.zst 后进入实际解压目录，运行 sudo ./install.sh，再启动 anki。
2. 打开后新建一个学习牌组，点击添加，选择基本卡片；正面输入问题，背面输入答案，保存后返回该牌组开始学习。先用自己熟悉的单词或知识点做几张卡片。
3. 回想答案后点击显示答案，再按实际记忆情况选择评分，让程序安排后续复习。需要跨设备时注册自己的 AnkiWeb 账户并使用同步；只在电脑本地学习无需账户。
faq:
桌面版需要付费吗？Anki 桌面版免费；iOS 的 AnkiMobile 独立收费，Android 的 AnkiDroid 是另一个开源项目。
必须联网吗？本地制卡和复习可以离线；下载、同步或部分扩展需要联网。
能用来学中文或外语吗？可用自己的文本、图片和音频制作卡片，具体学习效果取决于内容和复习习惯。
Linux 包为什么不是 ZIP？官方发行使用 tar.zst，安装 zstd 并按照官方解压和安装步骤操作。

## What's Changed

⚠️ Please upgrade to [26.09](https://github.com/ankitects/anki/releases/tag/26.09)+ as soon as possible as it includes important security fixes.

### Fixes

- Fix system-wide app upgrades on Windows not properly replacing old versions and causing startup crashes by @abdnh in https://github.com/ankitects/anki/pull/5626
- Fix "Card modified" error in the Cards Info screen when FSRS disabled or memory state is missing by @Luc-Mcgrady in https://github.com/ankitects/anki/pull/5648
- Append app version to the extracted tarball directory name on Linux by @Luc-Mcgrady in https://github.com/ankitects/anki/pull/5662
- Force software rendering in safe mode by @Luc-Mcgrady in https://github.com/ankitects/anki/pull/5637
- Fix the "Please restart to save changes" message shown multiple times in the preferences screen in some cases by @Luc-Mcgrady in https://github.com/ankitects/anki/pull/5641

### Documentation

- Improve manual translation instructions by @wofiporia in https://github.com/ankitects/anki/pull/5519

### Development

- Update Python dependencies to match bundled dependencies in 26.05+ by @abdnh in https://github.com/ankitects/anki/pull/5625
- Update Rust dependencies to fix CI failure by @abdnh in https://github.com/ankitects/anki/pull/5608
- Add tests for config.py and stdmodels.py by @roostwp07 and @fernandolins in https://github.com/ankitects/anki/pull/5513
- CI: Track releases in the SonarCloud project version by @fernandolins in https://github.com/ankitects/anki/pull/5634
- CI: Fetch PR base branch so SonarCloud diffs only changed files by @fernandolins in https://github.com/ankitects/anki/pull/5659
- Refactor: use col.fsrs_enabled in more places by @Luc-Mcgrady in https://github.com/ankitects/anki/pull/5651

## New Contributors

- @wofiporia made their first contribution in https://github.com/ankitects/anki/pull/5519

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ankitects/anki/compare/26.09.2...26.09.3

usageInstructions:
1. Windows 需要 Windows 10 1809 或更新版本及 Microsoft Visual C++ 运行库，解压完整 7z 后运行 goldendict.exe，不只下载单独 EXE。macOS 需要 13 或更新版本，选择 Intel 或 Apple Silicon DMG，将应用放入应用程序目录。
2. 准备自己有权使用的词典文件。在编辑 → 词典（Edit → Dictionaries）中打开来源 → 文件（Sources → Files），点击添加选择词典所在文件夹；需要扫描子文件夹时启用递归，再重新扫描。
3. 回到主窗口输入一个词，查看命中条目；在词典列表检查是否已识别文件，词典较多时可建立分组。扫描和建索引可能需要一些时间；具体支持格式和在线来源设置见官方文档。
faq:
安装后为什么查不到词？软件是查询工具，需要先添加自己的词典；检查文件格式、目录和扫描结果。
和原版 GoldenDict 是同一个页面吗？本页提供独立维护的 GoldenDict-ng，原版的软件版本和下载来源不同。
有 Linux 安装包吗？本次官方稳定 Release 没有 Linux 成品附件，本站不把源码或第三方 AppImage 当官方原包；Linux 用户可按官方文档使用发行版仓库或 Flatpak。
词典必须联网吗？本地词典可离线查询，在线词典或网站功能需要网络。
name: GoldenDict-ng
summary: 添加自己的词典，集中查词和全文检索。
description:
GoldenDict-ng 是桌面词典查询工具，支持多种词典格式、全文检索、深色主题和 Anki 集成。它是 GoldenDict 的独立维护分支，使用 Qt6 和 WebEngine；软件本身不提供商业词典内容，需要添加自己有权使用的词典。

项目采用 GPL 3 或后续版本，保留 GoldenDict 原作者 Konstantin Isakov 和 GoldenDict-ng 贡献者；CREDITS 原文明确其中部分是原项目历史贡献者，并非全部-ng作者。对应 26.8.0 源码：https://github.com/xiaoyifang/goldendict-ng/tree/v26.8.0 。三官方原包及依赖原字节保留，Windows 原 OpenCC copyright 中的 Apache 2 原文保留，不把依赖全部改成主GPL；同目录 GoldenDict-ng-26.8.0-LICENSES.zip 附原项目许可、README、贡献者与编译资源索引。官方产品PNG来自原programicon编译资源，词典配置截图来自官方文档，保留项目来源与主许可；本站介绍由本站编写，图片为官方示例。

usageInstructions:
1. Windows 选择匹配系统的 64 位或 32 位官方安装器；macOS 打开 Intel DMG，将应用放入应用程序目录，本页没有 Apple Silicon 原生包。Linux x64 给 AppImage 执行权限后启动，系统缺少 FUSE 等运行依赖时按官方安装文档处理。
2. 新建项目，导入自己的几段视频、图片和一段音频，将素材拖到时间线的轨道上。调整片段顺序，拖动边缘修剪长度，需要时加入转场、标题或颜色调整。
3. 点击预览播放检查声音和画面，保存项目。使用导出视频，选择输出目录、格式和画面规格，先导出一个短片检查结果；项目文件只是编辑记录，不是最终视频。
faq:
需要另外购买软件吗？OpenShot 是开源软件，本页为官方原包。
保存项目后为什么没有视频？项目保存素材引用和编辑记录，需要导出才能生成最终视频文件。
Mac ARM 可以直接原生运行吗？本次官方稳定附件只有 Intel Mac 包，不标成 ARM 原生；系统兼容性按官方说明判断。
3D 动画标题需要什么？部分功能依赖另外安装的 Blender 等工具，不是所有功能都要求它们。

releaseNotes:
Highlights & Features:
===
 - Upgraded Razor tool with source-frame previews, snapping, removal shading, and ripple cuts that close gaps on the same track.
 - Improved timeline navigation with persistent clip titles and effect controls, clearer zoom-slider handles, and more consistent thumbnails.
 - Faster color and keyframe editing, more responsive trim previews, and smoother live transform adjustments.
 - Fixed macOS startup failures caused by missing library dependencies on systems without Homebrew.
 - Improved stability, undo/redo history, project saving, asset handling, and compatibility with older project layouts.
 - Restored native file dialogs and improved Inkscape and Blender workflows, including access for editors installed as Snaps.
 - Added non-interrupting announcement banners. Dismissed update notices stay hidden until the next release.
 - Introduced official Linux Snap support with automatic updates and desktop menu integration.
 - Improved recording workflows, Linux webcam discovery, and Windows recording-file handling.
 - Refreshed interface and documentation translations in 25 languages, with clearer tooltips and improved video-editing terminology.

usageInstructions:
1. Windows 解压完整 ZIP，安装适合自己系统的 Java 8 或 11–23，进入解压目录运行 freeplane.bat。Linux Debian/Ubuntu 安装原 .deb，并按包管理器提示满足 Java 依赖；此包为 Java 通用程序。macOS 选择 Intel 或 Apple Silicon DMG，将 Freeplane 应用放入应用程序目录后启动。
2. 新建思维导图，将中心主题改为自己的计划或学习主题；选中节点后通过菜单添加子节点，给各分支添加具体事项。使用节点备注补充说明，需要时附上相关链接。
3. 折叠或展开分支检查结构，在思维图和大纲视图中查看内容，保存为 Freeplane 导图文件。分享给他人时按需要使用导出功能，原导图文件继续保留用于编辑。
faq:
Windows 的通用包需要 Java 吗？需要。它包含完整编译后的 Freeplane 程序，启动脚本使用本机 Java；请安装适合系统的运行环境。
Mac 包怎么选择？Intel Mac 选 Intel DMG，Apple Silicon 选 Apple DMG；两包的实际主程序架构已分别核对。
通用包是源码吗？不是。它包含实际 GUI 和启动器的 Java 字节码，原生启动器不代表整个 Java 程序的 CPU 限制。
截图与现在的主题一样吗？图片为项目官方历史文档示例，当前主题可能不同，主要展示工作区与导图/大纲的组织方式。
name: Freeplane
summary: 用思维导图和大纲整理计划与知识。
description:
Freeplane 是开源思维导图工具，可以建立主题与分支、编辑节点、添加备注和链接，在导图与大纲视图中整理工作计划、学习笔记和知识结构。本站提供完整官方原包，Windows 和 Linux 的 Java 通用包需要已有适合系统的 Java 运行环境。

项目采用 GPL 2 或后续版本，保留 Freeplane/FreeMind 作者和贡献者，原版权包括 Joerg Mueller、Daniel Polansky、Christian Foltin、Dimitry Polivaev。对应 1.13.3 源码：https://github.com/freeplane/freeplane/tree/release-1.13.3 。原包及依赖许可保持，Gentium 字体为 SIL OFL 1.1、listcontrols 字体由 Daniel Bruce 制作并采用 CC BY-SA 4.0，主题及日历等组件保留各自原文，不统一改成主GPL。随附 Freeplane-1.13.3-LICENSES.zip 保存主许可、原版权来源和相关独立通知；Mac 原运行环境的法律文件也在原包保留。产品图标和两张文档功能图保留项目来源，截图是官方历史示例，本站介绍由本站编写。

releaseNotes:
Tag category AI tools
Tag category scripting API
Copying selected chat messages as markdown
Options to show root node text or bookmark titles on tab titles and map menu labels
  - Preferences…->Appearance->Look and Feel->Tab titles
  - Preferences…->Appearance->Look and Feel->Maximum tab title length
Bookmarks outline and bookmark toolbar can follow the view root
Switch AI Chat tool availability between reading, editing and disabled
Add reusable AI prompts that are managed in a dialog like assistant profiles, exposed as dynamic actions
  - Tools->AI prompts->Edit prompts...
Thinking effort and temperature configuration
Search and filter AI model selectors in chat, reusable prompts and assistant profiles
  - Keep one session-wide filter across selectors
  - Navigate filtered models with Up and Down and confirm a model with Enter
Configure OpenAI, OpenRouter, Requesty, custom OpenAI-compatible, Gemini and Ollama providers concurrently
  - Manage provider and model settings in the separate AI models Preferences section
  - Keep separate service addresses, model lists and credentials for every provider
  - Support an optional credential and separate model-list address for custom providers
Automatically discover models confirmed to support text output and tool calling
  - Use native provider capabilities with exact OpenRouter metadata fallback where needed
  - Use an empty model list for automatic discovery or wildcard-only entries to filter discovered models
  - Treat literal model IDs as an explicit trusted list without discovery
  - Migrate user-defined legacy model lists while discarding obsolete bundled defaults
Keep unavailable selected AI models visible and prevent requests until an available model is selected
Show modal errors when reusable prompts have no available effective model
Reset individual or all Preferences values to their defaults
Bug fixes

usageInstructions:
1. Windows 选择适合系统的 64 位或 32 位官方安装器；macOS 解压原 ZIP，把 dupeguru.app 放入应用程序目录，官方包同时包含 Intel 和 Apple Silicon 程序。Debian/Ubuntu x64 安装原 .deb，并按包管理器提示满足 Python、Qt 等依赖。
2. 启动后用“+”或拖放添加要扫描的文件夹，先选择一个测试目录，使用默认设置点击扫描。根据需要切换标准、音乐或图片模式。
3. 在结果中逐组核对重复项与保留的参考文件。误匹配的项目先从结果中移除，确认后标记需要处理的重复项，通过操作菜单移动、复制或送入回收站；保留重要文件的备份。
faq:
扫描到的都是可以删除的文件吗？不是。相似名称或图片匹配可能包含误匹配，需要逐组确认；软件不会因为扫描完成就自动删除所有结果。
支持中文吗？项目提供简体中文翻译，部分帮助文档仍是英文。
Mac 要选两个不同包吗？本次官方 ZIP 的主程序和随包原生依赖同时包含 Intel 与 Apple Silicon 架构，是同一个通用包。
Linux 的包会自动带齐运行环境吗？此 Debian 原包使用系统 Python/Qt 依赖，安装时按包管理器提示处理，不把它当成免依赖 AppImage。
name: dupeGuru
summary: 查找重复文件，整理磁盘空间。
description:
dupeGuru 是重复文件查找工具，可以按文件名或内容扫描文件，也提供音乐标签和图片相似度比较模式。它把候选重复项分组显示，方便逐组确认后移动、复制或送入回收站，并支持简体中文。本站提供完整官方原包。

主程序采用 GPL 3，保留 Hardcoded Software、维护者与贡献者版权；对应 4.3.1 源码：https://github.com/arsenetar/dupeguru/tree/4.3.1 。hscommon、semantic_version 和运行环境等独立许可分别保留，不改成统一主GPL。dupeGuru-4.3.1-LICENSES.zip 随原包目录提供主GPL、原作者名单、历史 Debian 版权和已核实运行环境的原通知。Qt/PyQt、Python、OpenSSL 等的源码与通知来源记录在附件回执中，原软件包不改动。产品主图标由 Jérôme Cantin 制作，保留项目出处及 CREDITS；本站中文说明由本站编写。
releaseNotes:
This release fixes #1015 which can result in non-duplicate files being marked as duplicate when using the standard content mode scan.

## Changes Since Last Release
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/arsenetar/dupeguru/compare/4.3.0...4.3.1

### Features
* Update Italian translations

### Bug Fixes
* Fix issue where cache db exceptions could prevent files being hashed (#1015)
* Add extra guard for non-zero length files without digests to prevent false duplicates

## Other Notes
* Highly recommended for anyone using version 4.2.0 or later to update to this version, as the issue has existed since that version.
* Release files hosted here are signed with GPG ([sig](https://keys.openpgp.org/vks/v1/by-fingerprint/D276BDB7E11B3DD328935F71C63300DCE48AB2F1))

## OS packages

* Debian archives for x64 (binary archive only compatible with systems using python 3.7/3.8/3.9/3.10)
* RPM for x64, created from deb (only compatible with systems using python 3.7/3.8/3.9/3.10)
* macOS release is compatible with Intel and M1 Mac, and is signed, however not with a paid developer subscription (#945)
* Windows Packages have both installer (exe) and portable (zip) versions. **NOTE windows versions were built using python 3.8 and are only compatible with Windows 7 or later.**
* Arch Linux package is maintained by @glubsy at https://aur.archlinux.org/packages/dupeguru/
* Ubuntu PPA built by @eugenesan at https://launchpad.net/~dupeguru/+archive/ubuntu/ppa

usageInstructions:
1. Windows 解压匹配系统的 AMD64 或 ARM64 官方便携包，进入 bin 目录运行 xournalpp.exe；Mac 选择 Intel 或 Apple Silicon DMG，将 Xournal++.app 放入应用程序目录。Ubuntu 24.04（noble）及相应兼容系统选择 x64 或 ARM64 原 .deb，通过包管理器安装并满足系统依赖。
2. 新建笔记，选择笔或文字工具，在页面写下一段测试内容；调整颜色、粗细，使用橡皮、选择和形状工具整理笔记。需要分开管理时使用图层，并检查图层可见性。
3. 批注自己的 PDF 时，通过菜单打开 PDF，使用荧光笔、笔和文字工具添加注释。保存为可继续编辑的 .xopp 笔记，保留原 PDF；需要分享阅读时另导出 PDF，检查导出结果后再发送。
faq:
一定要手写板吗？不需要，鼠标和文字工具也可使用；手写笔与绘图板能提供更方便的输入。
保存笔记和导出 PDF 有什么区别？.xopp 用于继续编辑笔记，导出的 PDF 用于阅读和分享；建议同时保留笔记文件与原 PDF。
Linux 包适合所有发行版吗？本次官方原包面向 Ubuntu noble，相应系统依赖按包管理器处理，不把它当成无依赖通用 AppImage。
公式工具需要额外配置吗？LaTeX 等扩展功能需要相应环境，普通手写和 PDF 标注可先使用。
截图是当前系统主题吗？图片是官方历史示例，用于说明手写笔记和图层功能，当前外观可能不同。
name: Xournal++
summary: 手写笔记、绘图与 PDF 批注。
description:
Xournal++ 是手写笔记和 PDF 批注工具，可以用鼠标、手写笔或绘图板记录笔记，添加文字、形状和标注，并按页面与图层整理内容。适合学习笔记、阅读批注、草图和白板记录。本站提供完整官方原包，图片为官方历史功能示例。

主程序由 Xournal++/Xournal 团队与贡献者开发，采用 GPL 2 或后续版本；对应 1.3.8 源码和构建资料：https://github.com/xournalpp/xournalpp/tree/v1.3.8 。原程序包保持原字节。产品主图标版权 2020 Luya Tshimbalanga，许可 CC BY-SA 4.0（https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/）；本站仅转换 WebP 编码，保留作者、许可和图片来源。界面工具图标另含 GPL3、ISC 和 CC BY-SA4，不统一改成主GPL2。官方历史截图及作者来源保留，本站中文说明由本站编写。

同目录 Xournal++-1.3.8-LICENSES.zip 保留项目原 GPL、完整 copyright.txt 独立资源通知、原 Debian 版权、已核实 GTK/GLib/libsndfile/PortAudio 原通知与源码索引。动态运行库和字体等依各自原许可，源码与构建输入可从官方项目资料查阅；不声明原 Windows/Mac 包内都附齐外部许可文本。

usageInstructions:
1. Windows 解压与你电脑相符的 x64 或 ARM64 原包，在解压目录打开终端，执行 .\fastfetch.exe；这是终端程序，双击后窗口可能很快关闭。macOS 解压对应 Intel 或 Apple Silicon ZIP，在包内 usr/bin 目录的终端执行 ./fastfetch；可将该程序放入自己的 PATH 目录。Linux Debian/Ubuntu 按实际架构安装 .deb，并按安装器提示满足依赖。
2. 在终端运行 fastfetch 查看当前系统信息，执行 fastfetch --help 查看参数。部分硬件或环境模块依赖系统提供的信息，不能读取时不会保证有结果。
3. 需要自定义时运行 fastfetch --gen-config 生成 JSONC 配置，再按官方配置文档调整模块；先保留原配置副本。分享输出前查看是否包含自己的用户名、设备名或网络信息。
faq:
这是图形界面程序吗？它在终端输出信息，本站图为官方公开终端示例。
能用它测试电脑性能吗？它主要读取系统信息，不代替跑分、稳定性测试或温度监控工具。
为什么某些模块为空或不准确？结果取决于操作系统、驱动、桌面环境和可读取的数据，按官方文档核对对应模块。
Fastfetch 和 flashfetch 是两个独立软件吗？本包附带的 flashfetch 是同项目工具，本页按 Fastfetch 一款软件统计。
name: Fastfetch
summary: 在终端快速查看系统、硬件及桌面环境信息。
description:
Fastfetch 是命令行系统信息工具，可显示操作系统、CPU、GPU、内存、磁盘、终端与桌面环境，并通过 JSONC 配置调整显示模块和样式。适合整理设备配置、排查环境或分享系统信息；它不是硬件跑分或持续监控面板。本站提供官方稳定版原包，采用 MIT 许可，保留 Linus Dierheimer、Carter Li 及各第三方原通知。对应 2.69.0 源码和发行：https://github.com/fastfetch-cli/fastfetch/tree/2.69.0 。随附的 Fastfetch-2.69.0-LICENSES.zip 保存主许可与 yyjson、sixel、AMD 接口头文件等原声明；widecharwidth 上游配置声明为公共领域。官方图标和界面图来源归项目原作者，本站仅转换为 WebP。
